controls.title: MFA is enabled for all IAM users with a console password
controls.evidence_requirement: Per-user MFA enrollment is collected for console-enabled IAM users with no open un-enrolled finding.
controls.change_reason: Initial CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark mapping
controls.mapping_rationale: The AWS connector raises an open finding for any console-password IAM user without an MFA device, gating purely programmatic identities out; that finding is the direct test for this recommendation.

controls.title: Access keys are rotated every 90 days or less
controls.evidence_requirement: Per-user access-key age is collected and no active key exceeds the 90-day rotation window.
controls.change_reason: Initial CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark mapping
controls.mapping_rationale: The AWS connector raises an open access-key-hygiene finding when an active key is older than the 90-day rotation SLO (or more than one active key exists); that finding is the direct test for this recommendation.

controls.title: IAM password policy requires a minimum length of 14 or greater
controls.evidence_requirement: The account IAM password policy is collected and its minimum length meets the benchmark floor (>= 14).
controls.change_reason: Initial CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark mapping
controls.mapping_rationale: The AWS connector scores the account password policy against the benchmark length floor and raises an open config finding when it is weaker; that finding is the direct test for this recommendation.

controls.title: Data governance — training, validation, and testing datasets are appropriate

controls.mapping_rationale: EU AI Act Art. 10 — Training, validation and testing data sets shall be subject to data governance and management practices.

controls.title: Automatic record-keeping (logs) over the lifetime of high-risk AI systems
